supported_scope: Nonexactness of invariants for the infinite unipotent quotient; not a geometric counterexample.

claim_assessments.reason: q(x,y)=y is an equivariant surjection for U=[[1,1],[0,1]], but the fixed line Qe1 maps to zero. Finite monodromy is needed before finite-group averaging can repair the argument.

retired_because: A quotient alone need not surject on invariant sections for infinite monodromy; the unipotent quotient has invariant-lift image zero. Prove geometric finite monodromy first.
